title: payment-api returning 503 errors in dev
description: Users reported widespread failures when calling payment-api. Error rate spiked to 6% in dev. Logs show upstream connection timeouts and circuit breaker trips.
resolution_summary: Scaled payment-api replicas and restarted unhealthy pods. Root cause was connection pool exhaustion under peak load.

title: Database connection pool exhausted on user-auth
description: Monitoring alerted on user-auth in qa: all database connections in use. Queries queued and request latency exceeded 30 seconds.
resolution_summary: Increased pool size and terminated long-running queries. Added index on hot table to reduce lock contention.

title: Authentication failures after notification-service deploy
description: Following a deployment to stage, notification-service began rejecting valid tokens. Login success rate dropped sharply across regions.
resolution_summary: Rolled back the deployment and rotated signing keys. Updated config validation to catch mismatched issuer URLs.

title: Memory leak detected in inventory-db (prod)
description: Heap usage on inventory-db climbed steadily over 48 hours in prod. OOM kills restarted pods every few hours.
resolution_summary: Identified unclosed cache entries in recent release. Hotfixed memory cleanup and scheduled full redeploy.

title: Redis cache miss storm impacting checkout-frontend
description: checkout-frontend in dev experienced a cache stampede after TTL expiry. Database load surged and p99 latency degraded.
resolution_summary: Enabled request coalescing and staggered cache TTLs. Warmed critical keys before peak traffic.

title: SSL certificate expiry on order-processor load balancer
description: Clients could not reach order-processor in qa due to an expired TLS certificate on the load balancer.
resolution_summary: Renewed certificate and updated auto-renewal alerts. Verified chain trust across all edge nodes.

title: Message queue backlog on search-indexer
description: Consumer lag on search-indexer in stage exceeded one million messages. Downstream order processing stalled.
resolution_summary: Scaled consumer workers and replayed dead-letter queue. Fixed poison message handler that blocked partition reads.

title: Rate limiting misconfiguration on analytics-pipeline
description: Legitimate traffic to analytics-pipeline in prod was throttled after a config change lowered rate limits too aggressively.
resolution_summary: Restored previous rate limit thresholds and added staged rollout for gateway policy updates.

title: Disk space critical on cdn-edge nodes
description: Several cdn-edge hosts in dev reached 98% disk usage. Log rotation failed and write operations began failing.
resolution_summary: Expanded volumes and purged stale audit logs. Tuned log retention and added disk usage alerts.

title: Intermittent network partition affecting billing-service
description: billing-service in qa lost connectivity to a dependency zone for 12 minutes. Retries caused retry storms across services.
resolution_summary: Network team restored BGP routing. Added jittered backoff and bulkhead isolation between dependency calls.

title: DNS resolution failures for support-portal in stage
description: Internal clients failed to resolve the support-portal hostname in stage. Resolver timeouts caused cascading health check failures across dependent services.
resolution_summary: Fixed stale NS records and reduced negative cache TTL. Added synthetic DNS probes to catch resolver drift early.

title: Pod crash loop on mobile-backend after config rollout
description: mobile-backend pods in prod entered CrashLoopBackOff after a config map update. Startup probes never passed and traffic shift stalled at 45% capacity.
resolution_summary: Reverted config map and patched invalid environment variable references. Added schema validation to the deploy pipeline.

title: Third-party API outage blocking fraud-detection
description: fraud-detection in dev depends on an external vendor API that returned sustained 502 responses. Fallback logic did not activate and checkout flows failed.
resolution_summary: Enabled degraded-mode responses and cached last-known-good data. Opened vendor ticket and documented failover runbook steps.

title: Suspected data corruption in recommendation-engine records
description: Support escalations reported inconsistent account states served by recommendation-engine in qa. Audit sampling found mismatched version fields on 10% of recent writes.
resolution_summary: Paused write path, restored from point-in-time backup, and replayed events through a repaired serializer.

title: DDoS traffic spike targeting webhook-dispatcher
description: Edge metrics showed a 29× increase in anonymous requests against webhook-dispatcher in stage. Origin CPU saturated and legitimate users saw elevated error rates.
resolution_summary: Activated WAF rules and geo-fenced suspicious ASNs. Scaled edge capacity and enabled challenge mode for abusive IPs.

title: Feature flag misconfiguration in audit-logger
description: A flag rollout enabled experimental code for all tenants on audit-logger in prod. Error dashboards spiked within minutes of the change.
resolution_summary: Disabled the flag globally and restricted future rollouts to canary cohorts with automatic rollback thresholds.

title: Schema migration timeout on image-resizer database
description: An online migration against image-resizer in dev held table locks for over 20 minutes. Write traffic blocked and support tickets increased sharply.
resolution_summary: Cancelled migration, applied changes in smaller batches, and scheduled remaining steps during a maintenance window.

title: Log pipeline drop causing blind spots for subscription-manager
description: Log shipping from subscription-manager in qa fell to near zero. On-call engineers lost visibility while customer-impacting errors continued.
resolution_summary: Restarted log agents and increased buffer limits. Added alerts on ingest rate anomalies per service.

title: Cold start latency regression on geo-routing-service

resolution_summary: Pre-warmed minimum instances and trimmed startup dependencies. Tuned autoscaling signals to react on queue depth.

title: Webhook delivery failures from document-parser

resolution_summary: Restored compatible cipher suites and retried failed deliveries from the dead-letter store with idempotency keys.

title: Session store unavailable for metrics-collector

resolution_summary: Forced quorum recovery, rebuilt replica set, and extended session TTL temporarily while caches repopulated.
